column1: # Lebanon, Dar al-Fatwa: fit on its own mosque-screen feed (Masjidi TV id 26, Ras Beirut), all 365
# printable rows of the perpetual table mapped onto the real 2024 calendar (archive/tables/
# normalized-7e/lb-fatwa-beirut-2024.txt; found printed on a FIXED winter/standard UTC+02:00 clock all
# year, unlike the engine's real Asia/Beirut civil zone -- hence `clock` differs from `zone`, exactly
# as ps.iftaa's table; see proof.md for how this was found); test on 19 dated captures spanning
# 2019-2026 from the older homepage widget and Al-Liwaa's daily reprint of the same table, a genuine
# cross-year, cross-source holdout. One more dated capture (1 Apr 2023) prints on a clock that does
# not match Asia/Beirut's real DST for that date -- Lebanon's government decreed the 2023 clock
# change delayed to 20 Apr, and this capture (before that date) matches the fixed +2 clock within 0-2
# min on every event -- so it is included with its own fixed clock. 25 Jan 2023 and 28 Mar 2024 are
# excluded (see proof.md): the first a genuine widget bug, the second real on every other event but
# with a sunrise that would be 10 min late under the same reading, which no margin may ever be (an
# end, not a start), and which is not worth 11 more minutes of everyone else's sunrise to accommodate.
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): Dar al-Fatwa prints no end-of-eating column; the fast begins at its
# printed Fajr, so the Fajr column is also checked as the end of eating (F+E). The 20 deg end, its fitted
# margin and its recorded limit are in Levant.kt.
